description: One manually invoked remediation pass over the open PRs of the repo you are standing in. It moves each eligible PR one step toward landing or a clean exit, with remediation scaled to real author-activity age: nudge, repair, decide, retire. Plan-only by default; --apply updates behind branches, sets pr-minder's own labels and keeps one owned comment per PR. Never merges, closes, rebases, force-pushes or retargets. Trigger on /pr-minder, "mind the PRs", "which PRs are going stale", "nudge the stale PRs". Not a daemon and not multi-repo; landing stays with /merge-cleanup.
